content.text: In countries like Nigeria, where Stripe is severely restricted, building a digital store that accepts [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-guide|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-you-need|Crypto Payments]] payments is a challenge many creators face. But what if you could bypass Stripe altogether and create a store on Cloudflare Pages, accepting over 300 cryptocurrencies with no fees? This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nonsense-guide-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-2|no-nonsense]] guide shows you how, using COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack, and explains why this infrastructure works when platforms fail.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The problem with relying on platforms like Stripe is that they can restrict or shut down your account at any time, leaving you without a way to process payments. This is exactly what happened to many creators in Nigeria, who were forced to look for alternative solutions. COREMERCH's infrastructure is different - it's built on open-source tools like Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages, and NOWPayments, which give you full control over your store and payments. By deploying your own infrastructure, you can avoid the risks associated with relying on a third-party platform.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need to set up a few things. First, you'll need to create a Cloudflare account and set up a new site. Next, you'll need to install the NOWPayments plugin, which will allow you to accept crypto payments. You'll also need to create a Supabase account, which will store your order data. Finally, you'll need to configure your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings to ensure that your emails are delivered correctly.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages site. This will allow you to accept crypto payments and store them securely in your Supabase database. You'll also need to set up a delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, which will allow you to deliver your digital products to customers instantly.
You can deploy a store on Cloudflare Pages and accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with no fees using COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Testing before promotion is not optional — it is the step that determines whether your store functions correctly under real conditions before real buyers encounter it. The test sequence has four steps. First: deploy the backend and confirm the webhook endpoint returns a valid response to a test HTTP POST. Second: configure the storefront and confirm the checkout displays correctly on desktop and mobile. Third: complete a real mainnet transaction with a small amount of actual crypto. Fourth: check your order database and confirm the order was logged correctly, the delivery email arrived, and the download link works.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The most important question you may ask is: can I really build a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages without relying on Stripe? The answer is yes - using COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack, you can deploy a store on Cloudflare Pages and accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with no fees. This is made possible by integrating NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages site, which allows you to accept crypto payments and store them securely in your Supabase database.
The Edge Commerce Stack includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, making it ideal for larger stores.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For more information on building a digital store that accepts crypto payments, check out COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. You can also visit their website to learn more about their products and services. Additionally, you can browse their shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to see their offerings.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your store on Cloudflare Pages, follow these steps: Create a Cloudflare account and set up a new site. Install the NOWPayments plugin to accept crypto payments. Create a Supabase account to store your order data. Configure your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings to ensure correct email delivery. Integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages site. Set up a delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Go live with your store and process your first transaction.
Frequently Asked Questions
How long does it take to deploy the Sovereign Starter Stack?
The Sovereign Starter Stack can be deployed in as little as 4-6 hours using the Sovereign Blueprint.
What is the difference between the Sovereign Starter Stack and the Edge Commerce Stack?

The Sovereign Starter Stack is ideal for small to medium-sized stores, while the Edge Commerce Stack is ideal for larger stores. The Edge Commerce Stack includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, while the Sovereign Starter Stack includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments.
Can I use GitHub Pages instead of Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, you can use GitHub Pages instead of Cloudflare Pages. However, GitHub Pages may not offer the same level of performance and customization as Cloudflare Pages.
How do I configure my SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings?

To configure your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings, you'll need to add specific DNS records to your domain. This will ensure that your emails are delivered correctly and that you're protected from spam and phishing attacks.
Can I scale my store to handle more traffic and transactions?
Yes, you can scale your store to handle more traffic and transactions by setting up load balancing, caching, and other performance optimization techniques.
